text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The holiday season is nearly here...

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
The lineup for this year's Arima Kinen
grand prix
looks to be a step up above
usual.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, Super Creek, and Inari One
are just a
few of the Umamusume who've
been bringing the
heat this year.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
There's also Yaeno Muteki and Mejiro
Ardan. And
who could forget Sakura
Chiyono O's miraculous
comeback!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who's defined this generation
is going
to be there! Fans are calling it a
dream race
worthy of the grand prix
title!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is looking forward to the
imminent
Arima Kinen and the holiday
season. Meanwhile,
Bamboo Memory...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's get right to it, Trainer! It's the
holidays,
which means enforcing
discipline is more
important than ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to Bamboo Memory, the disciplinary committee is fairly—make that extremely busy around this time of year.
choice_data_list: O-Ohhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I decide to help out with
her
disciplinary committee work between
our training
sessions.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You can't take the holiday season
lightly! This
time of year is nuts!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The disciplinary committee has crunched
the
numbers and found that rule
violations go up
significantly around the
holidays! We call it chaos
season!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I think it's easier to understand if you
see for
yourself. So...
choice_data_list: T-The Cursed Christmas...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's patrol the academy! We need to
tighten the
screws, and that means being
three times as loud,
three times as strict,
and three times as energetic!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course—it sounds cool!
choice_data_list: ...Is there any reason for tripling it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins our super strict holiday
season.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You over there! It's against the
rules to bring
a tree into the dorms
without permission!

text_block_list.name: Tree-Toting Student
text_block_list.text: Oh! Bamboo! S-sorry about that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! Just because a classroom is
empty
doesn't mean you can use it to
throw a party! You
need to get
permission first!

text_block_list.name: Student with Fairy Lights
text_block_list.text:
Gyah! Where'd you come from?!
A-anyway...
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there! Who said you could
have a
barbecue on the roof?! Clean
everything up right
this instant!

text_block_list.name: Student Holding Meat
text_block_list.text:
But why?! Taiki Shuttle does it all the
time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And Air Groove yells at her every time!
Do you
want me to call her over here?!

text_block_list.name: Student Holding Meat
text_block_list.text: ...I'll clean it up.

text_block_list.name: Student in Casual Clothes
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bamboo! Thanks for all your hard
work on
the disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Did you get permission to leave campus?

text_block_list.name: Student in Casual Clothes
text_block_list.text:
Oh you! Of course I did! Hehehe... Now,
I'm just
gonna go ahead and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast! Your dorm leader's told me
all about
your habit of sneaking out!
And I know for a fact
you haven't given
notice! I checked!

text_block_list.name: Student in Casual Clothes
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I should have known you would've
talked
to her. There's no getting
anything by you...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That should do it for today!
Appreciate the
help, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spent the whole day patrolling with
Bamboo
Memory. Both the scale and
amount of rule
violations were larger
than I expected, and we've
managed to
run ourselves ragged.
choice_data_list: G-Good work today...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
See? We don't call this chaos season for
nothing.
Everyone's so excited, they just
do whatever they
feel like!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But that's all the more reason why I've
got to do
what I can for the disciplinary
committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I think everyone's just so excited about
the
holidays that they can't help
themselves!
choice_data_list: Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And so it's our job to make sure
everyone enjoys
the holidays safely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is working hard on the

disciplinary committee for everyone's
sake, and
I'd like to show her some
appreciation.
choice_data_list: ……I'd expect nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! Can we?! I'd love to!
choice_data_list: How about a little celebration in the trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We can celebrate a job well done and the holidays at the same time! Besides, who knows when we'll get another chance to celebrate?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yesss! This is gonna be great!
choice_data_list: Then how about I go buy some cake!
Then shall I go buy some cake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Bamboo Memory and I
reward
ourselves for our hard work by
enjoying the
holidays with some cake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us have a lovely time talking
about all
the times we've shared!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I nearly forgot! It's not a holiday party
without—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I left it in my room! And it's not
even
wrapped ye—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! Would you mind picking
up the
cake by yourself?
choice_data_list: ...Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll meet you back in your office! Just
gotta grab
something real quick, nothing
to worry about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry! I'll be there right away, I
swear!
Just wait a bit!
choice_data_list: I-I don't really get it, but got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As requested, I go pick up a cake and
then wait
for her in my office.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who suggested we make this
a holiday
party, but I totally forgot I
wasn't prepared...
choice_data_list: No, I'm fine, but what on earth is going on?
No, I'm fine, but what in the world happened?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays!
choice_data_list: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I figured today is the best time to give
you your
present since we're celebrating
and all!
choice_data_list: Wait!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I kinda had to rush a little bit with
the
wrapping 'cause I wasn't ready.
Anyway, it's
nothing special, but I hope
you like it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course!
choice_data_list: Thank you...!! Can I open it?
Thank you...!! May I open it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I unwrap my present from Bamboo
Memory and
find a super soft hand
towel inside!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's beautifully decorated with an
intricate
bamboo pattern, and the kanji
character for
"dreams" is embroidered
across one of the edges.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've told you my dad does kendo, right?
Well, he
and I both really love this
brand! Their towels are
durable, soft,
and super handy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You can use it to mop up sweat, or
whatever you
want, honestly. Here's
hoping you get a lot of use
out of it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Actually, I did that part myself!
choice_data_list: Thanks! This embroidery is really nice, too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't easy, but I had some help from
Ardan!
Still, I'm glad it turned out okay!
choice_data_list: What?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be a bit boring if I just
gave you
a towel, so I wanted to give it
my own special
touch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An attack of emotion sweeps over me,
and I
worry I might have to put the hand
towel to use
right away!
choice_data_list: Bamboo...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'm so glad you like it! The look
on your
face right now is the best
present I could ask for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now that we've exchanged
presents,
let's get this party started!
Thanks for all your
hard work and happy
holidays!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Bamboo Memory and I
reward
ourselves for our hard work by
enjoying the
holidays with some cake, all
the while chatting
about the times we've
shared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I promise myself that
I'll
treasure my new dream-embroidered
hand towel.
